title: A red main takes a proven fix as well as a revert, and the merge tool checks the proof
why: Owner chat ruling, word for word, relayed by the consultant at 09:20 CST Nov 17 (the time he typed it is not in the relay): "a) Allow a proven fix as well as a revert, and have the merge tool check the proof. Gain: no question and no 6-hour hold for the next flaky test. Lose: a fix that passes its own run but breaks something else lands on main without anyone asking you. (Recommended) approved". It changes rule git-red-main-reverts, which lets only the revert of the blamed commit merge on a red main.
source: Consultant message to triage 9, 09:20 CST Nov 17 (relayed, not read by triage 9 in the owner's own message). Searched steps at 09:21 CST: red-main-owner-two-picks, revert-merge-lifts-red-main and red-main-same-sha are different steps. Filed by triage 9.
